name: Broiled Caper Halibut with Cauliflower & Mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F) and place racks in the medium and lower positions of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium heads cauliflower
1.36 kg cremini mushrooms
1 ½ small bunches Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Remove leaves from cauliflower; cut into bite-sized florets and place in a large mixing bowl.
Cut mushrooms into quarters and add to the bowl with the cauliflower.
Drizzle cauliflower and mushrooms with oil and season with thyme, salt, and pepper; toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp thyme
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Divide veggies between two parchment lined baking sheets. Place baking sheets in oven and bake until golden, 6-8 minutes, tossing halfway through.
Shave leaves from parsley stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Set aside.
Cut lemons into wedges and set aside with parsley.
Spread the oil over the halibut using a spoon or your hands and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg halibut fillet
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When cauliflower is golden, place fish on top and sprinkle with capers. Bake until the fish is opaque, 5-7 minutes.
When fish is cooked remove from oven and set oven to broil. Sprinkle fish with raisins and return to oven; broil until raisins are plump and hot, about 30 seconds per pan.
Divide halibut and veggies between plates and drizzle with vinegar and any accumulated pan juices. Top with parsley and serve with lemon wedges. Enjoy!
